# Project Online

> Official resource for Project Online retirement guidance and migration to OnePlan, Microsoft 365's portfolio and project management solution.

Project Online is being retired as of September 2026. This site provides comprehensive migration resources, comparisons with alternative solutions like OnePlan, and support for organizations transitioning their project management infrastructure. The site emphasizes OnePlan as the recommended replacement while offering guidance on other Microsoft 365 and third-party alternatives.

## Key Topics

- Project Online Retirement
- OnePlan Migration
- Portfolio Management (PPM)
- Microsoft 365 Integration
- Project Management
- Resource Planning
- End-of-Life (EOL) Transition
- Azure DevOps
- Project for the web
- Smartsheet
- Jira
- Power BI
- SharePoint
- Teams
- Data Migration

- [Announcement - Project Online](https://project-online.com/announcement): Official retirement announcement for Project Online with September 2026 deadline
